local: Before the Mona Lisa, portraits lacked mystery, artists only represented outward appearances.
ja_pron: Monariza izen, shōzōga ni wa shinpi-sei ga kakete ori, geijutsuka wa gaiken dake o egaite imashita.
native: Before the Mona Lisa, portraits lacked mystery, artists only represented outward appearances.

en: Mona Lisa, however, is alive, a living, breathing woman with a soul.
zh: 然而，蒙娜麗莎是有生命的，一個有靈魂的活生生的女人。
ja: しかしモナリザは生きており、魂を持つ生き生きとした女性です。
local: Mona Lisa, however, is alive, a living, breathing woman with a soul.
ja_pron: Shikashi Monariza wa ikite ori, tamashī o motsu ikiiki to shita josei desu.
native: Mona Lisa, however, is alive, a living, breathing woman with a soul.

en: When you stand in front of the Mona Lisa, you are looking at more than just a portrait of an individual.
zh: 當你站在蒙娜麗莎面前，你看到的不僅僅是一個人的肖像。
ja: モナリザの前に立つとき、あなたは単なる個人の肖像以上のものを見ています。
local: When you stand in front of the Mona Lisa, you are looking at more than just a portrait of an individual.
ja_pron: Monariza no mae ni tatsu toki, anata wa tan'na kojin no shōzō ijō no mono o mite imasu.
native: When you stand in front of the Mona Lisa, you are looking at more than just a portrait of an individual.

en: You are looking at the accumulated knowledge of a genius who blended art, science and magic
zh: 你看到的是一位天才融合藝術、科學與魔法的累積知識，
ja: あなたは芸術、科学、魔法を融合させた天才の蓄積された知識を見ています。
local: You are looking at the accumulated knowledge of a genius who blended art, science and magic
ja_pron: Anata wa geijutsu, kagaku, mahō o yūgō saseta tensai no chikuseki sareta chishiki o mite imasu.
native: You are looking at the accumulated knowledge of a genius who blended art, science and magic

en: to create a profound meditation on what it means to be human.
zh: 創造出對人類意義的深刻沉思。
ja: 人間であることの意味についての深い瞑想を生み出しています。
local: to create a profound meditation on what it means to be human.
ja_pron: Ningen de aru koto no imi ni tsuite no fukai meisō o umidashite imasu.
native: to create a profound meditation on what it means to be human.

en: Whether she is Mona Lisa, Lagerkonda or Lagerkond, she is the face of a revolution in art.
zh: 無論她是蒙娜麗莎、拉格孔達還是拉格孔德，她都是藝術革命的象徵。
ja: 彼女がモナリザであろうとラジェルコンダであろうと、彼女は芸術革命の顔です。
local: Whether she is Mona Lisa, Lagerkonda or Lagerkond, she is the face of a revolution in art.
ja_pron: Kanojo ga Monariza de arou to Rajerukonda de arou to, kanojo wa geijutsu kakumei no kao desu.
native: Whether she is Mona Lisa, Lagerkonda or Lagerkond, she is the face of a revolution in art.
